n: Massimo 30 Inch Dual Fuel Range in with Air Fryer Basket, True Convection Oven, Matte Cast Iron Grates, and Antique Brass Handles
desc: The Massimo 30 Inch Dual Fuel Range in Black with Antique Brass Accessories blends professional performance with modern design. The cooktop features 4 powerful sealed gas burners and durable matte cast iron grates, along with a built-in wok ring and removable griddle for flexible cooking.
hl: Sealed Gas Burners: Four sealed burners provide precise heat control and help contain spills for easier cleanup.
Air Fryer Basket Included: Cook crispy meals with less oil using the built-in air fry function and included basket.
Matte Cast Iron Grates: Durable, heavy-duty grates support all cookware and hold up under high heat.
True Convection Cooking: 1500 watt convection fan ensures even heat distribution for faster, consistent baking and roasting.
30 Inch Dual Fuel Range: A compact, high-performance range that pairs gas burners with a true electric convection oven.
Removable Griddle and Wok Support: Versatile cooktop accessories let you sear, sauté, and stir-fry with ease.
